title: Mine Says ZERO Feet Away 📍
description:
In our town, every phone shows how far you are from your nearest family. Mine said ten feet my whole life, with Mom down the hall.

Last month I moved four hundred miles away, into one room on my own. My phone says zero, and at night something upstairs walks when I walk.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment ZERO if your mom would do this too.
